name: Boyish Minami Tou*
original_name: ボーイッシュ 南冬○
source:
Toma M*nami, a little boy-sh sister character, is on a movie. Even though it is her first time, she challenges hard action such as being in swimsuit, loincloth, and twister. Didn't her brothers say anything about it?
